## Tổng quan về thành phần hóa học

Loài *Portulaca oleracea* đã phân lập và xác định được 124 hoạt chất thuộc  về 23 nhóm gồm ?, benzene and substituted derivatives, betalains, carboxylic acids and derivatives, cinnamic acids and derivatives, coumarins and derivatives, dihydrofurans, fatty acyls, flavonoids, glycerophospholipids, heteroaromatic compounds, hydroxy acids and derivatives, indoles and derivatives, isoflavonoids, organic phosphoric acids and derivatives, organooxygen compounds, phenols, prenol lipids, purine nucleosides, saturated hydrocarbons, steroids and steroid derivatives, tetrahydroisoquinolines, unsaturated hydrocarbons.
